title: Number the PQ level of every protocol from 0 through 5
description: Number the PQ level of every protocol from 0 through 5
acceptance_criteria: Section 5.4.2 defines PQ levels 0 through 5. Everyday is 0. Extra lock is 1 while the 32-byte PSK stays secret. Hybrid handshake and message are 3. Levels 2, 4, and 5 are unused by a message protocol. 0x03 stays unassigned. README and SECURITY.md use those integers.
